behavior: answer_scale says the kind of scale, likert (symmetric around a neutral middle, 1..n meaning -2..+2 in analysis) or score (an ordered scale that only grows); both show numbered points 1..n, or stars with answer_scale_stars true; add_not_applicable adds the standard Not applicable answer below the scale, stored as not_applicable, never preselected and never a point.
sha256: SHA-256 of the question object serialized as compact UTF-8 JSON
